newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela foreign debt at $25.4 bln end 1996-paper.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela foreign debt at $25.4 bln end 1996-paper.

text.p: Venezuela's public foreign debt stood at $25.443 billion at the end of 1996, down 1.459 billion or 5.4 percent from the end of 1995, according to Finance Ministry figures published by local daily Economia Hoy.
Of the $25.443 billion total, $17.608 billion was Brady bond debt and $7.835 billion was non-restructured debt.
Brady bond principal payments started to come due in 1997.
Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar has said the government is considering proposals from various investment banks to restructure its foreign debt payments.
